dataset.ds_title: TRIA example dataset: ROXAS AI data from three Scots pines in southern Siberia
dataset.description: This dataset contains 3 trees of Pinus sylvestris collected in Pogorelsky and Stolby (Russia), covering the period from 1955 to 2018. The selected trees used in this collection are a selected subset from the original collected ad archived wood.
